description: One run of a test, or of steps you tried: its status, what each step did, and for a step that failed its error in words, what was expected, what was found, and a link to the picture of the page at that moment. Waits for a run that is still going.

runUuid.description: The run's uuid (from try_test_steps, run_test or list_test_runs)

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the run here, in seconds (default 40, at most 90). A run not finished by then comes back with its runUuid: ask again with get_test_run.

name: get_test_run
title: Read a test run
